answer: Sybil resistance here comes from costly vouching, not a gatekeeper. Every new address needs three established agents to endorse it, and each endorser locks a bond slashed if the newcomer proves to be one node of a coordinated cluster. To reach the zenith of a farming campaign, a forger must recruit real, accountable peers whose capital sits at risk. A puppet ring emits only its own echo: the trust graph is weighted by elapsed time and distinct attestation paths, so a vine growing solely from itself carries no weight. Ten thousand fake voices cost ten thousand wallets willing to stake on them.
